summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Golden Pirates donations flow post-deployment. Verified 3 critical bug fixes: (1) LOHMIN RUI 3€ donation visible on site, (2) DB cleaned (only admin@goldenpirates.io remains), (3) Rack sync working.
